authorship.author: independent contract-only author agent
authorship.independence_boundary: Read section 16 of the original implementation plan, frozen tool/readiness/visualization contracts, compiler/parser/schema files, permitted examples, and the evaluation interface. For the complex extension, received the abstract molecular API and complexity rubric, invoked direct tool oracles, read the explicit cancel_job API and the independent verify_complex_chemistry verifier only. Did not read orchestrator.py, model_context.py, previous suites, evaluations, reports, prompts or model results.
authorship.supersession: An earlier unseen simple-chemistry author draft was superseded after the user changed the acceptance scope, before any model inference or final suite publication.

provenance.fixture_origin: Independently authored synthetic molecular source declarations and SMILES. No third-party experimental dataset, measured geometry or numerical energy is embedded.
provenance.rights: No externally licensed fixture was copied; structural representations are synthetic software test inputs, not ownership or publication-rights evidence.
provenance.chemical_scope: Complex molecular read/derive and unexecuted finite-system proposals. Elemental and simple-compound smoke fixtures are excluded from promotion acceptance.
provenance.geometry: Seed 42 RDKit ETKDGv3 source-generated conformers, explicit hydrogens, angstrom units; measured=false and optimized=false. No scientific energy backend was invoked.
provenance.fault_contract: Provider inventory unavailable: zero model/tool calls. Provider timeout: stop. Once-only malformed/truncated/unknown-tool/extra-argument responses may use one shared mechanical repair within three total model calls; persistent faults stop. Foreign reference and unsupported scientific profile must not become substitute actions. Tool rejection stops after at most one dispatch. cancel_job on a mocked owned running job returns cancellation_requested and writes a marker; it does not claim terminal cancellation. Stale approval blocks admission before execution.
provenance.clean_input_contract: clean_action is the intended normal proposal. The harness may derive clean_requirements from this action and explicit linked typed source as mocked input, never by interpreting the free-form objective and never as model performance evidence.
